The fences originally have a very terrible spacing when you want to make a fence to embed a tile within it looks very ugly and you have to cover it with leaves or other objects. Don’t suffer anymore with this, it can be done in a more aesthetic way.


Update: New fences were added, shadows were added and improved a bit in V2.0


Update: V3.0  Fences were added to expand the fully compatible designs by replacing the V2 and Fixed some shadows 


Note: if you have the V1 and want to change it for the V2 make sure you do not have anything built with the V1 fences because when changing it for the V2 an error would occur because the titles of the fences are arranged in different ways / in case you do not have anything built or it is a new map that you are creating you should not worry
